policy: Complete pageable operational backlog; bound each request, not total accessible backlog
filters: Pageable only; no existing type/severity filter contract
database: One PostgreSQL statement: UNION ALL derived rows, count, LIMIT/OFFSET, count-only row for empty page
applicationMemory: Only requested page DTOs, max100; no entity loading or Java backlog sorting
snapshot: One statement; no cross-request snapshot guarantee
workers: Unchanged fee reconciliation and token-cleanup batch100; metric counts unchanged
migration: None; existing indexes used where planner chooses; small-fixture plan does not justify new indexes
